title: Evaluation compatibility with the canonical resolution comparison
statement:
Let $h:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $U\to S$ etale, $W=U\times_S Y$, $A=h^*\mathbb Z[U]$, and $I$ a bounded-below complex of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ whose restriction to $W$ is K-injective. Use the generator $g$, the functor $T=H^0R\Gamma(W,-|_W)$ and $x=\mathrm{zeroIso}^{-1}(g)$ of [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Let $\delta:T(QI)\cong H^0(\Gamma(W,I|_W))$ be the canonical `resolutionSectionsIso`, the composite of exact restriction's localization comparison, the inverse derived-sections unit on the K-injective restriction, and homology's localization comparison. For every chain map $f:A[0]\to I$,
$$\delta(T(Qf)(x))=\mathrm{chainEvaluation}(f),$$
where `chainEvaluation` is the explicit chain-level map of [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-homotopy-sections-iso]. The inclusion of the bounded-below derived category is used to regard $Qf$ as a morphism there. This statement is an equality of maps on chain representatives, and asserts no bijectivity of evaluation.

source.place: Tag 03Q8; Cohomology on Sites Tags 072W (injective section complexes), 0BKV and 0D6F (restricted K-injective computation)

proof.text: Unfold resolutionSectionsIso: its three factors are the exact restriction localization comparison, the inverse right-derived sections unit on the K-injective restricted complex, and the homology localization comparison. Naturality identifies their composite with H^0 of the termwise restricted sections chain map.

For the source A[0], zeroIso is the degree-zero derived-to-underived comparison followed by the single-complex homology isomorphism. Their compatibility sends zeroIso.inv(generator) to the generator class used in underivedSingleIso.inv(generator). Naturality with f therefore gives chainEvaluation exactly. This calculation uses no existence or choice of the homotopy isomorphism and works for zero maps and empty W.

lean.statement:
theorem rawRestricted_resolution_evaluation {S Y : Scheme.{v}}
    (h : Y ⟶ S) (U : S.Etale)
    (I : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    [CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj U).hom).mapHomologicalComplex
         (.up ℤ)).obj I.obj)]
    (f : (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h).obj (freeSheaf S U)) ⟶ I.obj) :
    let W := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h).obj U
    let A := (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} h).obj (freeSheaf S U)
    let T := sectionsFunctor W ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0
    let x := (zeroIso W A).inv (generator h U)
    (resolutionSectionsIso W I).hom
        (T.map (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimage
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map f) :
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj A ⟶
              DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj I) x) =
      chainEvaluation h U I.obj f
